descriptionPlain:
About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team:
Our Key Offerings are divided into 5 broad categories as follows:
• Entertainment
• Digital Platforms
• CVM Solutions
• Enterprise Services
• Financial Platforms

One97 has the widest and largest deployment of telecom applications on cloud platforms in India and has a myriad of VAS services that have helped operators augment their revenue even in complex markets like India, SAARC, Middle East, Africa and many more.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Growth & Product Manager with strong telecom domain experience to drive business growth, consulting engagements, and client relationships. The candidate will work closely with telecom operators to identify revenue monetization opportunities, develop customer engagement strategies, and recommend solutions leveraging CVM, analytics, and digital platforms.
The role requires a combination of business consulting, growth strategy, product understanding, client management, and internal stakeholder coordination.
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with telecom operators to understand their business objectives, challenges, and revenue drivers, and identify opportunities for business growth and monetization.
Develop and recommend growth strategies to improve ARPU, revenue, customer acquisition, retention, cross-sell, upsell, and customer lifetime value.
Drive consulting engagements around Customer Value Management (CVM), campaign management, customer lifecycle management, segmentation, targeting, and personalized customer engagement.
Identify and define business use cases across prepaid, postpaid, broadband, and digital services, leveraging subscriber behaviour, usage patterns, and customer analytics.
Manage client relationships and act as a key point of contact for business discussions, requirement gathering, solution recommendations, and ongoing engagements.
Conduct client workshops, business reviews, and strategic discussions with stakeholders across Marketing, CVM, Digital, Analytics, and Business teams.
Translate client business challenges into actionable growth initiatives, product use cases, and functional requirements, working closely with int

About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role:
We are looking for early-career Product Managers who are ready to take independent ownership of a product pod or charter. The role involves understanding customer problems, defining product priorities, collaborating with Design and Engineering, launching products, and continuously improving outcomes through data and customer feedback.
This opportunity is ideal for professionals who have built a strong foundation in Product Management within a fast-paced B2C company and are ready to take on greater ownership. Product Analysts who actively influence product decisions and work closely with technology teams are also encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities:
1) Own a product pod or charter with clearly defined customer and business objectives.
2) Identify customer problems through data analysis, user research, market insights, and product funnel analysis.
3) Define product roadmaps, priorities initiatives, and make informed trade-offs.
4) Develop clear product requirements and collaborate with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, and Business teams throughout the product lifecycle.
5) Design and run experiments, evaluate outcomes, and scale successful initiatives while maintaining product quality.
6) Track key product metrics and continuously improve the user experience based on data and customer feedback.
7) Leverage AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, documentation, testing, and product development.
8) Take end-to-end accountability for outcomes, proactively identify risks, and navigate ambiguous problem statements.

What We Are Looking For:
1) Around 3–5 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Product Analytics, Business Analysis, or related product roles.
2) Experience in a scaled consumer internet company, high-growth startup, marketplace, commerce, fintech, travel, mobility, or another fast-paced B2C business.
3) Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives with measurable customer or business impact.
4) Strong understanding of product discovery, prioritization, funnel analysis, experimentation, and product delivery.
5) Hands-on experience with Android or iOS pr

About the team:
Paytm Ads is digital advertising vertical that offers innovative ad solutions to clients across industries It offers
advertisers the opportunity to engage with 300Mn+ users who interact with over 200 payment; retail services,
online and offline - offered on the Paytm app. Paytm Ads maps the user transactions to their lifestyle choices
and creates customized segmentation cohorts for sharp shooting ad
Job Responsibilities:
-Own ad revenue for assigned accounts / verticals vs monthly & quarterly targets.
-Build pipeline of media briefs; win rate on pitches, proposals & RFPs.
-Drive account retention, expansion & upsell / cross-sell.
-Present Paytm Ads to CXOs, media heads, brand managers & agencies.
-Deliver campaigns to agreed client KPIs (reach, engagement, ROAS / performance).
-Recommend & adapt Paytm Ads solutions to client needs.
-Lead cross-functional initiatives for innovative ad solutions.
-Feed performance & CX insights to Product for platform improvement.
Desired Qualifications: 
● 7+ years of relevant experience.
● Proven experience in managing programs / categories / business verticals
● Strong stakeholder management experience; ability to work cross-functionally and with a wide range of
employees with different skill sets
● Ability to deep-dive into a problem; very strong analytical and presentation skills required
● Ability to thrive and perform in an ambiguous setting; sound judgment and flexibility in balancing
program requirements, tight deadlines, and keeping people and projects moving on schedule
 
Why join us
●        A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
●        Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
●        A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
●        Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
